description: This file declares functions and structures related to the 'upload pack' operation in a version control server implementation, likely for handling Git upload-pack requests.

methods.name: upload_pack
methods.description: Handles the upload pack request, initiating the process with specified flags for advertising refs and stateless RPC, and a timeout.

methods.name: upload_pack_v2
methods.description: Version 2 of the upload pack handler, operates on repository and request packet reader structures.

methods.name: upload_pack_advertise
methods.description: Prepares and sends advertisement of references for the upload pack process.
